book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Qasseka Yerusalaameppe yida Farsaawetinne Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti Yesusaakko shiiqidi,
«Nena kaallizayti kase nu aawata wogaa aazas dhayssizoo? Quma maanaas kushe meecettettenna» gida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Intte intte wogaas giidi Xoossa azazo ays shaareetii?
Xoossi, ‹Ne aayonne ne aawaa bonchcha; ba aawa bolla woykko ba aayi bolla iita qaala haasaydaadey hayqqo!› gi azazides.
Intte gidikko ay asikka ba aawaa woykko ba aayo, ‹Ta inttes ooththanaas bessizaaz ay miishshika Xoossas yarsho ooththa shiishshadis› giikko,
‹He addezi ba aawaa woykko ba aayo bonchchides› geeta; hessa gishshas intte woga gishshas Xoossa qaala shaareeta.
Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo! Isayaasi intte gishshas yootishe,
Yesusi asaa baakko xeygidi, «Siyite wozinan woththite.
As tunisizay izaade doonara haa kezizayssafe attiin doonara duge gelizay tunisenna» gides.
Qasse iza kaallizayti izakko shiiqidi, «Farsaaweti ne gidayssa siyidi hanqettidayssa eradii?» gida.
Izi isttas, «Ta Aawaa saloyssi tokkontta miththi wurikka dhoqallettana.
Istta aggaagite; istti qooqeti kaaleththiza qooqeta gidida gishshas, qooqeti qooqe kaaleththiko nam7ay issoy issaara oykettidi aafon wullana» gides.
Phexroosi Yesusa, «Ne yootida leemisoza nuus birsha» gides.
Izikka, «Intte ha7i gakkanaaska eribeekketa guussee?
Doonara gelizay wuri duge qanth kanththidi gede kare kezizayssa erekketii?
Doonara kezizay gidikko wozinappe pulttees. As tunisizay hessa.
Iita qofay, shempo wodhoy, laymay, laymatanaas qaaqqatoy, kaysoy, wordo markkateththinne asa sunth mooroy wuri wozinappe pulttees.
As tunisizay haytanttafe attiin kushe meecettontta muusi as tunisenna» gides.
Kanaane Dere Maccassay Ammano
Yesusi heeppe kezidi Xiroosenne Sidoona geetettiza dere bides.
Issi Kanaane maccas dizaara he heerappe kezada Yesusaakko yaada, «Godoo, Dawite nawu! Taas mishetta! Ta naya tuna ayanay oykkiin keeha waayawus» gaada waassadus.
Gido attiin izi issi qaalakka izis zaaribeenna. Histtiin he wode iza kaallizayti izakko shiiqidi, «Nuna kaalla kaalla waayisiza gishshas ne izo moyza» giidi iza oychchida.
Izikka isttas, «Tani Isra7eele keeththafe dhayda dorsatakko xalla kiitettadis» gides.
Maccassayakka Yesusa toho bolla kundada, «Godoo! Tana maaddarkkii!» gadus.
Izikka izis zaaridi, «Nayta kath ekkidi kana butulatas yegganaas bessenna» gides.
Izakka, «Ee Godoo; butulatikka ba godaa maaddafe gaden wodhdhida kath maxi meettes» gadus.
Yesusikka maccassayo, «Hanne maccassayee, ne ammanoy gita! Ne koyida mala nees hano» gides. Maccassay naya heerakka paxadus.
Yesusi heeppe dendidi Galila abbaa lanqe biidi heen diza issi zuma bolla kezi uttides.
Qoodan daro derey wobbeta, qooqeta, silata, haasayontta duudeta haratakka daro harganchchata ehidi iza sinththan woththides; izikka istta paththides.
Duudey haasayshin, toho silay paxishin, wobbey sitti gi hemettishin, qooqey xeellishin be7idi asay malalettides; Isra7eele Godaakka galatides.
Yesusi Oyddu Shii As Mizides

Yesusi bana kaallizayta xeygidi, «Asay tanara heedzdzu gallas gam7ida gishshassinne maana kaththi baynda gishshas asay tana michchees. Oge bollan gafan daaburdi kundontta mala mela ulora yeddana koykke» gides.
Iza kaallizayti, «Hayssan aykkoyka baynda bazzo biittan hayssa keena dere mizanaas gidiza quma nu awappe demmanee?» gida.
Yesusi istta, «Inttes aappun ukeththi dizee?» gi oychchiin isttika, «Laappun ukeththinne qii guuththa moleti deettes» gida.
Izikka derezi gaden uttana mala azazides.
Laappun ukeththaanne moleza ba kushen oykkidi galatidaappe guye menththidi bana kaallizaytas immides; isttika deraas gishida.
Asay wurikka miidi kallides; Yesusa kaallizayti asaappe attidayssa laappun leemate kumeth shiishshida.
Midaytikka naytinne maccassay baynda addeti xalla oyddu shii gidida.
Yesusi dereza moyzidaappe guye wogolon gelidi Megidoone geetettizaso bides.
